This plot is very small, just a small piece near the house, and I am young with not much cash of my own. I will put some manure from our animals because we have it at home, it costs nothing. I cannot afford a full bag of DAP for such a tiny plot — one bag is too much and too expensive, so I will skip the chemical fertilizer this season like I did last year. I will use the seed we saved from last harvest, my mother and I will do all the work ourselves, no need to hire anyone for such a small piece.
